title: Noor Haddad Photography
headline: Documentary wedding photography, no stiff posing
bio: I photograph weddings the way they actually feel: the zaffeh, the tears at the katb el-kitab, the last dance. Full-day coverage with an online gallery within four weeks.

title: Petra Light Studio
headline: Bright, colourful photos with a team of two
bio: A husband-and-wife team covering both sides of the family. Albums printed in Amman.

title: Frame & Motion Films
headline: Cinematic wedding films and same-day edits
bio: A three-minute highlight film shown at your reception, plus the full ceremony and speeches. Drone footage where the venue allows it.

title: DJ Sami Nights
headline: Arabic and Western sets that keep every generation dancing
bio: From the zaffeh entrance to the last dabke. Sound system, lighting and a backup set-up included.

title: Al Tarab Band
headline: A six-piece band for classic Arabic tarab
bio: Oud, qanun, violin, percussion and two vocalists. We play the classics your grandparents love and the songs your friends request.

title: Layla Mansour
headline: Bridal entrance songs and live sets in Arabic and English
bio: I sing your entrance song live and lead the room through the evening, with a keyboard player or a full band.

title: Al Fursan Zaffeh
headline: A traditional zaffeh with drums, horns and swords
bio: Twelve performers in traditional dress lead the couple in with tabl, mizmar and a sword dance.

title: Rana Events & Planning
headline: Full planning or on-the-day coordination
bio: From choosing the venue to the last guest leaving, I handle suppliers, timings and family logistics so you can enjoy the day.

title: Bloom House Flowers
headline: Kosha flowers, bouquets and table centrepieces
bio: Fresh flower design for the kosha, bridal bouquet, entrance and tables, with set-up and take-down included.

title: Glow by Dana
headline: Soft bridal makeup that lasts all night
bio: Bridal makeup with a trial session, plus makeup for mothers and bridesmaids at home or at the venue.

title: Studio Sahar Hair
headline: Bridal updos, waves and veil styling
bio: Bridal hair with a trial, plus styling for the bridal party. I come to you.

title: Henna by Mais
headline: Traditional and modern henna for the henna night
bio: Detailed bridal henna and quick designs for guests. Natural henna only.

title: Sugar Atelier Cakes
headline: Tiered wedding cakes and dessert tables
bio: Custom tiered cakes with fresh flowers or sugar work, plus kunafa and dessert tables for the reception.

title: Aqaba Lens
headline: Beach and desert weddings in the south
bio: Based in Aqaba, covering beach weddings and Wadi Rum elopements, with sunset portraits included.
